text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to introduce a stop control for northbound traffic on Sidney Street at Cottingham Street to clearly establish right-of-way and enhance pedestrian, cyclist and vehicular safety.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized a compulsory stop control for northbound traffic on Sidney Street at Cottingham Street. 2. Amended the existing heavy trucks prohibition in effect at all times on Cottingham Street, between Poplar Plains Road and Avenue Road, to be in effect from Poplar Plains Road to the east end of Cottingham Street.
